requirement.description: IOBufferInstance fails to properly validate and handle IOPort instances, causing TypeError when trying to process IO ports like 'io-port None' or 'io-slice (io-port None)'
requirement.contract: IOBufferInstance constructor should properly validate that pad arguments are IOPort instances and handle various IO port types correctly. When pad is not an IOPort instance, it should raise a TypeError with the message "Object {pad!r} cannot be converted to an IO value".

requirement.description: Layout classes are not properly handling conversion to integers, causing TypeError when trying to interpret layout objects as integers. Many tests fail with "'StructLayout' object cannot be interpreted as an integer" errors.
requirement.contract: Layout classes should implement proper __int__ method that raises TypeError with descriptive message when attempting to convert layout to integer. The error message should be "cannot convert {self.__class__.__name__} to int".

requirement.description: StructLayout.from_bits method is missing or improperly implemented, causing AttributeError when tests expect this method to be available.
requirement.contract: StructLayout class should implement a from_bits method that takes a bits parameter and returns a View of the structured data. This method should properly convert the bits to a constant and wrap it in a View with this layout.

requirement.description: SingleEndedPort and DifferentialPort classes have issues with concatenation and inversion operations, causing TypeError for unsupported operand types.
requirement.contract: SingleEndedPort and DifferentialPort classes should properly implement __add__ and __invert__ methods to support concatenation and inversion operations. The __add__ method should return a new port of the appropriate type when combining ports, and __invert__ should return a new inverted port.

requirement.description: Fragment.prepare method has issues with port validation and domain propagation, causing TypeError when processing ports with invalid types or incorrect error messages.
requirement.contract: Fragment._prepare_ports method should properly validate port types and raise TypeError with correct messages when port validation fails. The error message for invalid port types should match expected format exactly. Domain propagation should work correctly for all domain combinations.
